claims.text: The resort is set amid AlUla's sandstone canyons and UNESCO World Heritage sites.

findings.quote: Set amidst AlUla’s breathtaking sandstone canyons and UNESCO World Heritage sites

claims.text: The resort sits in the Ashar Valley, a 20-minute drive from AlUla town.

findings.quote: The resort sits in Ashar Valley, a 20-minute drive from AlUla town

claims.text: The villas are sustainably designed to embrace the natural surroundings of the Ashar Valley.

findings.quote: Our villas are sustainably designed to embrace the natural surroundings of the Ashar Valley.

claims.text: The Arabian Villas are the resort's largest and most secluded accommodations, with views of the Ashar Valley.

findings.quote: Our Arabian Villas are our largest and most secluded accommodations, featuring pristine views of the sweeping Ashar Valley

claims.text: Thuraya Wellness has a lounge with an alchemy bar, spa treatment rooms, a fitness center, an outdoor wellness agora and a yoga studio.

findings.quote: Thuraya Wellness offers a peaceful lounge space with an alchemy bar, spa treatment rooms, a fitness center, an outdoor wellness agora, and a yoga studio.

claims.text: The infinity pool is set against the cliff.

findings.quote: the infinity pool pinned precisely against the cliff

claims.text: Programming includes sunrise yoga on the Ashar Deck and live music featuring local talent.

findings.quote: From sunrise yoga on our Ashar Deck to live music featuring local talent

claims.text: The resort offers a Hegra day tour to Saudi Arabia's first UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its Nabataean tombs.

findings.quote: Explore Saudi Arabia’s first UNESCO World Heritage Site of well-preserved Nabataean tombs

claims.text: Stargazing at Gharameel combines the area's rock formations with dinner outdoors.

findings.quote: Experience the enchantment of desert, surrounded by Gharameel’s mystical rock formations, and enjoy dinner alfresco.

claims.text: Several Desert X AlUla art installations are dotted across the valley.

findings.quote: Several colourful Desert X AlUla installations by the likes of Lita Albuquerque and Manal Aldowayan are dotted across the valley

claims.text: Tama, the resort's restaurant, takes its name from the Aramaic for 'here and now'.

findings.quote: Tama, meaning ‘here and now’ in Aramaic

claims.text: Tama's menu ingredients come from local farms in communities around AlUla.

findings.quote: The ingredients in our menus are sourced from local farms in communities surrounding AlUla

claims.text: Every villa has canyon views, a private outdoor lounge deck, a king-sized bed and both indoor and outdoor showers.

findings.quote: All of our villas offer scenic canyon views, private outdoor lounge decks, king-sized beds, indoor & outdoor showers

claims.text: Celestial Villas come with telescopes.

findings.quote: Our Celestial Villas feature telescopes

claims.text: The Art Villas look out on one of the Desert X installations, such as Falling Stones Garden or Najma.

findings.quote: Our Celestial and Canyon Art Villas tap into our creative spirit with views of one of the Desert X installations, including Falling Stones Garden and Najma.

claims.text: Guests can hike the resort's 8km Adventure Trail and stargaze with a local expert.

findings.quote: Hike our 8km Adventure Trail and historical treasure site, stargaze with a local expert under the clear night sky

claims.text: A complimentary daily program covers art and culture, wellness, adventure, learning, food and beverage, and music.

findings.quote: we offer our guests a complimentary daily programming schedule centered around our six pillars: Art & Culture, Wellness, Adventure, Learning, Food & Beverage and Music.

claims.text: All villas are on the ground floor and are not accessible via lifts.

findings.quote: All of our villas are located on the ground floor and not accessible via lifts.

claims.text: Rollaway beds are not available at this time.

findings.quote: Rollaway beds are not available at this time.

findings.quote: Professional photography and drone usage is strictly prohibited at Our Habitas AlUla and Caravan by Habitas AlUla properties without prior approval.
